vendors.name: ABlyft
vendors.h1: We keep Enterprise A/B-Testing affordable
vendors.h2: The A/B testing platform that meets your privacy requirements, is rocket fast, and provides the best capabilities for implementing your experiments.
vendors.summary: ABlyft positions itself as an enterprise-grade A/B testing platform built for developers and experienced marketers — 'affordable enterprise A/B testing' for organizations with many test developers. Privacy-first and GDPR-compliant. Free plan available with no credit card; full-feature Enterprise plan priced on request with unlimited experiments, customization, and priority support. Client-side JavaScript API (GET calls, experiment retrieval) is the documented developer integration; no SDK list for other languages. GA4 integration with detailed guide for connecting via GTM and querying ABlyft variation IDs in GA4 explorations. No documented Adobe Analytics, Segment, or data warehouse integrations. No MCP server. No AI/agentic features documented. GDPR is the only compliance certification publicly disclosed. Operating in 2026 with active site and docs.

vendors.name: Datadog
vendors.h1: Eppo is now Datadog Experiments
vendors.h2: We've spent the last year building a new generation of experimentation platform: trustworthy, self-service experimentation and feature flagging for every team. Now on Datadog.
vendors.summary: Contextual Bandits deliver real-time AI personalization with full warehouse-native execution. Auto-Generate Explore Charts automatically surface statistically significant slices in experiment results. Automated Slack alerts flag traffic imbalances, anomalous metric drops, instrumentation gaps, and data pipeline errors. AI Personalization positioning aligns with the warehouse-native bandit approach. Note: Eppo was acquired by Datadog in 2025 and is being merged into Datadog Experiments.

vendors.name: Omniconvert
vendors.h1: Customer Value Optimization platform for SaaS & ecommerce
vendors.h2: Identify your best customers and run experiments that move the metrics that matter — from acquisition to retention.
vendors.summary: Omniconvert is a Romanian conversion optimization platform offering two products: Explore (A/B testing, personalization, surveys, overlays, multivariate testing with both Bayesian and frequentist statistical models) and Reveal (customer-retention and value analytics platform for Customer Value Optimization — surfaces revenue performance, repeat-purchase drivers, toxic products, high-value segments). Server-side testing via SDKs in PHP, TypeScript/Node.js, Java, Kotlin (Android), and Swift (iOS/macOS). AI-Powered CRO Audit scans sites for conversion leaks and recommends test ideas. AI Growth Engine (Nexus) connects acquisition, conversion, and retention. Pricing tiers: Free, Essential, Expert (~$79/mo billed annually), Advanced — visitor-based with discounts at scale. Free tier includes 50K monthly tested views with full Explore feature set. Integrations: GA4, Klaviyo, Shopify, Segment, Sendgrid, Gorgias. Released CSV export for main-goal conversions in March 2026 — actively maintained. ICP: mid-size to large e-commerce merchants seeking data-driven CRO and retention. No MCP server, no SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO 27001 publicly disclosed, no data warehouse connectors documented.

vendors.name: Confidence (Spotify)
vendors.h1: Experiment like Spotify
vendors.h2: We fail fast and we learn fast, with Confidence. Now you can too.
vendors.summary: Confidence is warehouse-native experimentation from Spotify whose AI surface is expressed primarily through MCP rather than in-product assistants. It runs two vendor-hosted streamable-HTTP MCP servers: a Documentation MCP at https://mcp.confidence.dev/mcp/docs requiring no authentication, exposing semantic search with maximum-marginal-relevance ranking, regex search, full-source retrieval and SDK integration guidance; and an authenticated Flag Management MCP at https://mcp.confidence.dev/mcp/flags exposing nine tools to list, read, create and modify flags, add variants, update schemas, create override rules, test flag resolution with an explanation of why a variant was selected, and analyze flag usage to find unused or fully rolled-out flags. Flags carry structured schemas with named variants resolved against evaluation context, and applied-flag events are written to the data warehouse for later experiment analysis. Confidence's public positioning is that AI-accelerated code production increases, rather than reduces, the need for experimentation and guardrails. No generative-variant, bandit or autotune capability is documented on Confidence's own pages.

vendors.name: Sitecore
vendors.h1: Conversion optimization for real-time personalization and testing
vendors.h2: SitecoreAI helps you make each one count with real-time personalization powered by live audience insights. Deliver tailored experiences using real-time metrics from Audience and Insights.
vendors.summary: SitecoreAI splits its AI into assistants and agents: assistants handle quick interactive work - improving content in real time, personalizing pages, supporting A/B testing and optimization, creating deliverables and smart briefs, providing brand guidance, and translating a page or an entire site - while Agentic studio agents coordinate multi-step marketing processes, with brand kits applied across generation, optimization and translation. Documented AI features include running an A/B/n test with an AI-optimized variant and personalizing pages with AI. For external agents, Sitecore ships the Marketer MCP server plus a REST Agent API: MCP exposes Agent API endpoints as tools (for example a create_page tool), and every action still passes through Sitecore security, permissions and approval workflows. Sitecore markets Marketer MCP as a way to launch pages, run SEO audits, manage content, personalize and optimize from a single AI chat in Claude or Copilot Studio, and to pull other tools' MCPs into one governed workflow. Beyond first-party MCP, Sitecore has opened interoperability to partner agentic platforms, with Gradial as the first such integration; base page-builder personalization remains rule-based, extensible with Sitecore Personalize and CDP.

vendors.name: Shoplift
vendors.h1: Your store's CRO Copilot
vendors.h2: Launch high-impact split tests, unlock insights, and take the guesswork out of optimization.
vendors.summary: Shoplift is positioned as 'Your store's CRO Copilot' for high-growth Shopify brands. Lift Assist™ is an AI-driven recommendation engine that generates new test feature ideas in real-time, leveraging the brand's data and test ideas from hundreds of top brands. Bayesian Predictive Analysis predicts test duration in real-time and provides statistically robust significance estimates. Real-time statistical significance with automated insight dashboards surface actionable recommendations after a test completes. Shopify Plus Certified. Plans: Core $74-$99/mo (50K-100K visitors), Advanced $299/mo (100K visitors, adds Lift Assist + GA4 + JS API), Pro $699/mo (250K visitors, dedicated account manager). 14-day free trial. No MCP server documented; no compliance certifications publicly listed.

vendors.name: LaunchDarkly
vendors.h1: Move at AI speed. Stay in control.
vendors.h2: LaunchDarkly helps teams safely manage code and AI agents in production with feature flags, progressive delivery, automated rollback, and runtime control.
vendors.summary: LaunchDarkly's AI surface is AgentControl: configs that externalize prompts, instructions and model settings from application code, in completion or agent mode, with variations, targeting, monitoring, experimentation and attachable judges for online evaluation. In July 2026 LaunchDarkly added Agent Optimization in public beta, which runs systematic optimization passes across models, prompts and configurations, scores them with a judge model, and deploys the winner from LaunchDarkly. AgentControl monitoring can now be filtered and grouped by context kind, attributing AI cost, latency, tokens and satisfaction to individual tenants or users. For agent-driven operations, LaunchDarkly runs a hosted OAuth MCP server at https://mcp.launchdarkly.com/mcp/launchdarkly spanning feature management, AgentControl and observability, with a local npx server for federal and EU instances. LaunchDarkly also publishes installable agent skills that drive multi-step workflows such as flag cleanup through to a pull request.

vendors.name: Symplify
vendors.h1: CRM? No, we do much more than that…
vendors.h2: Future proof whatever you choose to call it. Your competitors are… CRM. Marketing Automation. AI. Conversion Testing. Consumer Data Insights. That's a lot of name calling when you could simply say Symplify.
vendors.summary: Symplify is a Swedish Customer Engagement Platform positioned beyond pure CRO — spanning CRM, Marketing Automation, AI/Predictive Marketing, Message Automation, Ultra User Personalisation, and Testing & Experimentation as four core pillars. The experimentation module combines A/B testing, visitor recordings, heatmaps, and frustration click measurement. OpenAI integration generates text and images directly within the Symplify editor, claimed to reduce content-creation time by up to 60%. Symplify AI provides machine-learning-based predictive features: Lifetime Value scoring, churn likelihood, VIP identification, and first-visit personalization. PHP SDK only for server-side testing. Native GA4 event integration (detects gtag/GTM automatically). GDPR-compliant under Swedish/EU data-protection law with SSL encryption and 2FA. Strong vertical focus on iGaming (multiple gambling partnerships including GiG), Fintech, Retail, NGO & Education, and Hospitality. Operating in 2026 with active press releases. No MCP server; no SOC 2, HIPAA, or ISO 27001 publicly disclosed.

vendors.name: VWO
vendors.h1: Digital Experience Optimization
vendors.h2: VWO is the market-leading digital experience optimization solution that fast-growing companies use for experimentation & conversion rate optimization.
vendors.summary: VWO Copilot is an AI assistant layer spanning the experimentation workflow: Editor Copilot generates design variations from text prompts, AI-Generated Ideas scans pages and adds hypotheses to the backlog, and Copilots also assist with heatmap and session-recording analysis, page selection and segment generation. Campaigns can be created directly through Copilot from natural language. VWO now runs two MCP surfaces: a vendor-hosted OAuth server at https://mcp.vwo.io/mcp (with EU and Asia endpoints) whose access is gated by Browse, Design and Publish-Admin scopes and which exposes campaign overview and A/B campaign creation tools, and a self-hosted FME MCP server (npx vwo-fme-mcp@latest, account ID + API key) for feature-flag create/update/delete and environment toggles from the IDE. Together these make VWO addressable by external agents for both marketing-side campaign work and developer-side flag management.

vendors.name: Optimizely
vendors.h1: AI-powered digital experiences that turn heads
vendors.h2: Create content fast. Personalize with ease. Test, analyze, and repeat. Then scale it all with AI and see what your team is capable of.
vendors.summary: Optimizely's AI layer is Opal, an agent-orchestration platform spanning Optimizely One with 50+ pre-built agents, no-code agent building, workflow orchestration, knowledge integration, quality evaluation and human-in-the-loop review. Inside experimentation, Opal supplies AI variation generation, AI test-idea suggestions, AI variation summaries and Opal Chat, and Optimizely reports 58.74% of all Opal agent usage is experimentation across 47,000 interactions at 900 companies. Q3 2026 additions include image generation and editing, Voice Mode, Brand and Channel Packs, Virtual Teammates and native human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints. Optimizely now exposes two of its own MCP servers - Experimentation (exp_* tools for query, manage and SDK implementation) and Analytics (oa_* tools for discovery, exploration building and scorecard analysis) - both OAuth-authenticated through Opti ID/Opal. Contextual bandits remain the per-user personalization mechanism, optimizing the primary metric using user attributes rather than one global winner.

vendors.name: Adobe Target
vendors.h1: A/B Testing Software
vendors.h2: Discover Adobe Target, the leading AB testing software that empowers you to optimize user experiences and drive conversions with personalized, data-driven insights.
vendors.summary: Adobe Target's most significant recent AI/agentic development is its own MCP server, in public beta and hosted by Adobe at https://targetmcp.adobe.io/mcp, which lets AI assistants inspect, analyze and manage A/B tests and personalization activities in natural language. It exposes 41 tools across 10 categories covering activity inspection and audit, performance/revenue/A4T reporting for A/B, XT, AP and Auto-Target activities, creation and update of A/B and Experience Targeting activities, traffic-split and variant management, activity state control, audience and HTML/JSON offer management, and implementation audit of at.js settings and response tokens. Access is OAuth 2.0 through Adobe Experience Cloud with no static credentials, and tool availability is gated by Target role: Observer for read, Editor for write, Approver for activation. Adobe attaches an explicit 'as is' risk disclaimer to MCP integrations and recommends sandbox testing first. Target's own AI-driven activity types, Automated Personalization and Auto-Target, remain first-class and are reportable through the MCP.

vendors.name: Conductrics
vendors.h1: A unified engine for experimentation, adaptive optimization, and customer research
vendors.h2: Unlock the power of intentional learning. Conductrics brings behavioral testing and qualitative feedback together in a single, flexible platform, so you can turn insights into immediate value for your customers.
vendors.summary: Conductrics positions itself as a unified engine for experimentation, adaptive optimization, and customer research — combining behavioral A/B testing with qualitative feedback in one platform. Core differentiator: adaptive optimization with interpretable machine learning that automatically allocates traffic to higher-performing variants (conceptually a contextual bandit approach, though Conductrics avoids that label). Trusted by Spotify, Experian, and Pfizer. HIPAA-compliant design for regulated environments — distinctive for an experimentation platform. SOC 2 Type 2 certified. Algorithmic transparency emphasized as a design principle. Custom enterprise pricing only — no public tier table. Native analytics integrations: Google Analytics (including GA4) and Adobe Analytics across client-side, server-side, and native mobile. No MCP server, no data warehouse connectors, no public ISO 27001 statement. Remains independent and operating as of 2026.

vendors.name: ABsmartly
vendors.h1: The most developer-friendly A/B testing platform
vendors.h2: Advanced experimentation and feature flagging platform designed to help teams validate ideas quickly, measure impact reliably and roll out changes safely.
vendors.summary: ABsmartly is intentionally not AI-marketed — positioning is 'built by developers for developers' for trustworthy A/B testing. The Health Check Panel is positioned as an 'experimentation copilot' for real-time anomaly detection (Sample Ratio Mismatch, Audience Mismatch, Variable Conflicts) but is rule-based monitoring rather than generative AI. Group Sequential Testing engine accelerates test cycles by 20-80% vs fixed horizon, twice as fast as standard sequential testing. Warehouse Native mode runs analysis inside customer's data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Redshift, Databricks). Hybrid deployment mode planned. An MCP Server GitHub repository exists (absmartly/mcp-server) but is not yet documented in product docs. LaunchPad browser extension enables non-technical users to launch tests. Pricing: event-based, starts at €60,000/year for 50M events/month with unlimited seats/experiments/goals.

vendors.name: Intelligems
vendors.h1: AI that understands the realities of your business
vendors.h2: You don't want best practices — you want to know what's going to work for you.
vendors.summary: Intelligems is positioned as 'AI that understands the realities of your business' for Shopify merchants. AI Visual Builder (beta) lets users describe on-site changes in natural language and the AI builds brand-matched modifications. AI-driven experiment recommendations suggest which profit levers (price, discount, shipping) to test based on historical performance. Automated pricing suggestions analyze site-wide analytics to recommend optimal price points. Intelligems MCP Server exposes store-level data (experiments, catalog, analytics, audiences, custom events) to AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) via standardized OAuth-authenticated API — enables conversational decision-making with profit-per-visitor breakdowns. Plans: Core $79/mo (< 3K orders), Plus $499/mo, Blue $999/mo. 14-day free trial. Data Sharing add-on supports Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, and cloud storage.

vendors.name: Webtrends Optimize
vendors.h1: Webtrends Optimize: Next Generation
vendors.h2: Webtrends Optimize is a simple to use, yet extremely powerful testing and personalisation platform using Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) tools to drive better visitor experiences on your website and increase ROI.
vendors.summary: Webtrends Optimize is a UK-based enterprise A/B testing and personalization platform positioning itself as a market-leader for high-traffic consumer-facing sites in e-commerce, media, travel, and financial services. Comprehensive AI suite under 'AI with Purpose' branding: AI Predictive Heatmaps (attention maps for experiment design), Synthetic User Testing (simulated user interactions for research), AI Coding Copilot (in-UI assistance for building/debugging tests), Visually Similar Product Recommendations (AI extracts category/style/color/texture from product images), AI Auto Insights (automated experiment analysis), and AI for Analysis (open-beta May 2026). Pricing based on annual sessions with enterprise-custom contracts — specific tiers not publicly disclosed. Cross-platform SDKs: JavaScript tag, Android (Java/Kotlin AAR), iOS (Swift/Obj-C). Push integrations to GA4, Adobe Analytics, Segment. Snowflake pull integration imports user profiles for segmentation. GDPR and CCPA compliance. No MCP server, no SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO 27001 publicly disclosed, no documented BigQuery/Redshift connectors. Hybrid or Managed Service offering targets large brands with dedicated CRO teams. Operating in 2026.

vendors.name: PostHog
vendors.h1: Dev tools for product engineers
vendors.h2: PostHog is an all-in-one developer platform for building successful products. We offer product analytics, web analytics, session replay, error tracking, feature flags, experimentation, surveys, data warehouse, a CDP, and an AI product assistant.
vendors.summary: PostHog AI is an in-product AI analyst that answers plain-English questions against the project's own events, persons and warehouse schema, writes the SQL, builds insights, and also acts - creating dashboards, surveys, alerts and feature flags, editing filters in the UI, and persisting project memory across conversations. It is reachable in the web app, inline throughout the UI, and via Slack in beta, and can hand code changes to a connected repository and return a pull request. Self-driving PostHog goes further: background agents cluster signals from errors, session replays, support tickets and external tools into reports and open PRs in a sandbox, with a human required to merge. Agent access is first-class - a free hosted MCP endpoint at https://mcp.posthog.com/mcp exposes function-calling tools across every PostHog product, including full experiment lifecycle control and governed semantic-layer metrics. Some MCP tools call LLMs internally and are only available when AI data processing is enabled.

vendors.name: Uniform
vendors.h1: Connect. Orchestrate. Ship. Optimize.
vendors.h2: The agentic DXP that adapts to your needs. Get powerful CMS, orchestration, personalization, and agentic AI out-of-the-box, plus seamless integration with any existing tools.
vendors.summary: Uniform's AI is anchored on Scout, an agentic assistant that executes rather than suggests: it creates pages and content from natural-language briefs, optimizes existing pages for SEO, accessibility and performance, suggests audience segments and builds personalized variations and A/B tests, auto-tags content, and translates compositions and entries into target locales. Agent access runs in both directions: the Uniform MCP server exposes 30+ tools across content, assets, structure, releases, classification, optimization and utilities so external clients like Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot can manage a Uniform project, while external MCP servers can be connected into Scout. The MCP server is reached over HTTP at https://ai.uniform.global/projects/<project-id>/mcp with an x-api-key service-account or personal access token holding the Developer role. LLM-backed MCP tools consume Uniform AI credits and apply changes immediately, without Scout's pending-edit review step. Uniform recommends pairing the MCP server with its AI rules so assistants have the conceptual model needed to use the tools well.

vendors.name: Monetate
vendors.h1: The Experience Optimization Platform
vendors.h2: Monetate is the Experience Optimization Platform—helping the world's leading brands design, test, and deliver digital experiences that are relevant, trustworthy, and valuable.
vendors.summary: MONET is Monetate's AI engine providing real-time adaptive intelligence across personalization, recommendations, and experimentation — marketed as agentic AI that 'continuously learns, acts, and improves outcomes.' Customer-facing GenAI assistant offers on-demand best practices and tailored guidance. Intelligent Personalization is the AI-powered decisioning engine for 1:1 personalization with sub-20ms decisioning latency. Action Variables (custom context variables via JS API or Engine API) enable rule-based or AI-informed triggers. Acquired SiteSpect in June 2025, merging zero-flicker server-side testing with AI-native personalization. Repositioned in September 2025 as the 'Experience Optimization Platform' with unified personalization + experimentation + discovery suites. Owned by Kibo Software. No Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for external AI assistants documented.

vendors.name: AB Tasty
vendors.h1: One platform for all your progress
vendors.h2: We're the experience optimization partners pushing brave ideas from the inside out. The only digital experience platform you need.
vendors.summary: Stack of AI Copilots powers experimentation workflows: Visual Editor Copilot (variant generation from prompts), Report Copilot (highlights winning variations), Hypothesis Copilot, Feedback Analysis Copilot. EmotionsAI profiles visitors by emotional and content interest segments for personalization targeting. AI agent 'EVI' for agentic experimentation workflows. AI-driven content personalization predicts visitor intent in real time. Note: AB Tasty merged with VWO in January 2026 under Wingify (Everstone Capital), creating a combined experimentation platform. An MCP server exists as an unofficial npm package (@abtasty/mcp-server) but is not yet in official AB Tasty docs.
vendors.seoTitle: AB Tasty Review 2026: Features, Pricing & Alternatives
vendors.seoDesc: AB Tasty is a proven enterprise choice for marketing-led experimentation and personalization. Compare pricing, AI and MCP capability, and alternatives.
vendors.seoH1: AB Tasty review: features, pricing, and alternatives

vendors.name: Convert
vendors.h1: Proven A/B Testing Tool
vendors.h2: Convert.com's A/B testing tool has split testing, personalization, advanced goals, fast support, and monthly payments.
vendors.summary: AI Wizard in the Visual Editor suggests headlines, supporting text, and variant copy/design (beta). Smart Traffic Allocation via Multi-Arm Bandits dynamically optimizes traffic. Dynamic Triggers and BYOID (Bring Your Own ID) for stable bucketing. Self-hostable MCP server lets AI assistants (Claude Code referenced in official blog) create and update experiences programmatically — positioned as 'A/B testing without UI.' AI features are privacy-focused: Editor Wizard trained on synthetic and de-identified data. Servers hosted in Frankfurt, Germany for EU data residency.

vendors.name: Zoho Pagesense
vendors.h1: All-in-one platform for conversion rate optimization
vendors.h2: Track, analyze, optimize, personalize, and engage visitors to turn traffic into conversions.
vendors.summary: Zoho PageSense is the conversion optimization platform within the Zoho suite. Four pillars: A/B testing (split-URL, full-stack, server-side), conversion optimization (funnel analysis, form analytics, goal tracking, session recording), heatmaps (visual, scroll, click), and personalization. Zia AI assistant is embedded across Zoho suite — can answer questions about experiment performance, suggest test ideas, and trigger PageSense actions. Zoho operates a workspace-level MCP platform (zoho.com/mcp) that exposes Zoho app actions to LLM-based agents (Claude, ChatGPT) via standardized JSON-over-HTTPS protocol; PageSense actions can be exposed through this MCP but no PageSense-specific MCP documentation exists yet. SDKs: .NET/C#, Android (Java/Kotlin), iOS (Swift/Obj-C). Integrations: Zoho ecosystem (CRM, Flow, Forms, Commerce, SalesIQ), GA4, GTM, Mixpanel, KISSmetrics, Google Ads, Intercom. Pricing: Forever Free (5K users), Professional, Enterprise (10K+ users with full A/B testing), Agency edition. Strongest compliance footprint among mid-tier CRO vendors: ISO 27001, ISO 27701, HIPAA (toggleable per project), GDPR, SAML SSO, anonymized IP, privacy masking in session recordings. No data warehouse connectors documented; SOC 2 not specifically referenced (though likely at Zoho suite level).

vendors.name: Harness FME
vendors.h1: Feature Management & Experimentation
vendors.h2: Release faster with feature flags connected to critical impact data and always know whether your software changes are making things better or worse.
vendors.summary: Inside FME, Harness ships Release Agent, an in-app multilingual AI chatbot grounded in Harness documentation and blogs that answers SDK, flag, targeting, experiment-interpretation and cleanup questions without leaving the UI, plus AI Summarize, which summarizes feature-flag metric tiles, individual experiment metrics and overall experiment results; both are admin-toggleable under FME Settings > AI settings. Platform-wide, Harness launched Autonomous Worker Agents in June 2026 - agents that run as governed pipeline steps on customer-controlled Delegates, produce auditable outputs, and draw memory from the Harness Knowledge Graph while drawing capability from the Harness MCP. The MCP server itself is open source and self-hosted (npx harness-mcp-v2, Docker, or from source) and routes 11 consolidated tools to 139 resource types across 30 toolsets, including Feature Management and Experimentation, with 27 pre-built prompt templates. Authentication is via a Harness personal access token, with an enterprise SSO path documented for MCP. For FME specifically, agents can discover projects, list and inspect flags, compare a flag across environments and identify fully rolled-out flags safe to remove.

vendors.name: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization
vendors.h1: Engage customers with relevance — anytime, anywhere
vendors.h2: Personalise every interaction a customer has with your brand with real-time recommendations in Agentforce, Marketing, and Service Clouds.
vendors.summary: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (formerly Interaction Studio/Evergage) delivers real-time 1:1 personalization, recommendations and decisioning across web, email and mobile, now with native web experimentation: marketers create experiments against a traffic subset, define custom primary and secondary metrics, and review lift, chance-to-beat-control and chance-to-beat-all analytics, with experiment data drillable in Data Cloud and exportable to BI tools. Custom engagement signal metrics, compound metrics and first/last-touch attribution models feed recommenders and decisioning. Agentforce integration runs both directions: Personalization context actions preface Agent topics so agents decide with visitor context, while Agentforce Actions translate live conversation intent into structured signals for the decisioning engine. Agent access is governed at the Salesforce platform level through Hosted MCP Servers using per-user OAuth 2.0 with PKCE; those servers cover SObjects, Data 360, Tableau Next and customer-exposed Apex/Flow tools, but no Personalization-specific MCP server is documented. Pricing now itemises Agentforce Personalization Decisioning, AI objective-based recommendations and AI-driven next-best offer.

vendors.name: Contentful Personalization (formerly Ninetailed)
vendors.h1: Personalization at scale for composable architectures
vendors.h2: Drive higher engagement with your customer journeys. Test, analyze, and refine the performance of your experiences — now part of Contentful Personalization.
compliance: EU-U.S. / UK / Swiss Data Privacy Framework
vendors.summary: Ninetailed was acquired by Contentful in August 2024 and lightly rebranded to 'Ninetailed by Contentful' / 'Contentful Personalization.' The original ninetailed.io domain now redirects to Contentful's Personalization product page. Combined offering integrates Ninetailed's AI-driven personalization and experimentation directly into Contentful's composable content platform — marketers can create, manage, and optimize personalized experiences from within Contentful in a no-code environment. Capabilities: AI-powered A/B testing optimization, custom segmentation, in-depth analytics, audience targeting across composable architectures. Documented customer outcomes: 78% conversion lift (Kraft-Heinz), 87% higher CTRs (Ace & Tate), <30 min implementation (Ruggable). Available as a Twilio Segment destination. For current product details (pricing, MCP, SDKs, compliance), refer to Contentful's documentation rather than the legacy Ninetailed materials.

vendors.name: Varify.io
vendors.h1: The Google Optimize Alternative That's Simple, Affordable & GDPR-Ready
vendors.h2: Transparent prices. Unlimited traffic. The A/B testing platform built for marketing teams.
vendors.summary: Varify.io is a German A/B testing platform explicitly positioned as the 'Google Optimize Alternative That's Simple, Affordable & GDPR-Ready.' Built for marketing teams and agencies who want a GDPR-ready A/B testing tool without developer overhead. Flat-rate pricing with unlimited traffic and unlimited tests across all plans: Growth €149/mo, Pro €249/mo (adds BigQuery integration + advanced segmentation + priority support), Enterprise (custom). Cookie-less operation, EU-hosted (Frankfurt). AI CRO Audit and Prompt-Based AI features generate optimization ideas and test suggestions — the Varify AI Assistant can generate test variant code from short prompt descriptions. Visual editor + code editor included on all plans. Native GA4 reporting (in-app, auto-detected). BigQuery integration on Pro+ tiers for warehouse export. Other integrations: Matomo, Piwik Pro, Snowplow, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar. No MCP server documented. GDPR-compliant by design; SOC 2 and ISO 27001 inherited from AWS/Cloudflare hosting infrastructure but Varify itself is not certified directly (stores no personal data). 2,700+ teams worldwide as of 2026.

vendors.name: Croct
vendors.h1: Optimize your website for each user
vendors.h2: Personalize your content, experiment with different journeys for different users, and drive more conversions without over-relying on your developers.
vendors.summary: Croct is a headless personalization, A/B testing, and feature-flag platform built for developer-centric product teams. Positioned around 'component-based headless CMS with built-in AB testing and personalization' for engineering and growth teams in SaaS, e-commerce, and digital products. AI-powered website segmentation automatically discovers high-value visitor segments in real time. Event-based expressions allow audiences to react to past behavior via the Croct Query Language (CQL) — functions like a 'memory' for segmentation. JavaScript-only SDK stack: core JS SDK, Next.js SDK, React SDK. One-click Vercel integration with automatic API-key provisioning. Free tier available with no credit card; custom enterprise pricing for advanced features. G2 Leader in Headless CMS, Personalization, AB Testing, and Component CMS categories (Winter/Spring 2026). No MCP server documented. No compliance certifications (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001) publicly stated. Operating in 2026.

vendors.name: Mutiny
vendors.h1: Your AI agent for creating anything customer-facing
vendors.h2: Be the one buyers remember. Join the frontier of how the best GTM teams operate.
vendors.summary: Mutiny is positioned as an AI agent that creates customer-facing content (1:1 landing pages, deal rooms, pitch decks, business cases, meeting recaps, case studies, pricing proposals) from natural-language prompts. Mutiny's AI pulls in CRM data, call transcripts, and account research to personalize at scale. The Mutiny MCP server (HTTP + OAuth) connects Claude, ChatGPT, IDEs, and any MCP-compatible client to generate Mutiny assets within conversational AI tools. Visitor Intelligence integrations with Outreach and Salesloft surface buyer signals. Originally a B2B website personalization tool, Mutiny pivoted to an agent-first content generation product. Pricing: Free, Business at $50/seat/month, Enterprise starting $30,000/year.

vendors.name: GrowthBook
vendors.h1: Build Smarter. Ship Faster.
vendors.h2: The warehouse-native platform used by modern product teams for experimentation, feature flags, and product analytics.
vendors.summary: GrowthBook is now explicitly agent-operable: version 5.0 (July 2026) shipped 25 open-source agent skills, an in-app AI Assistant, and a CLI covering 100% of the REST API, so agents can create flags, configure ramps, launch experiments, query analytics, conclude winners and clean up stale flags, with agent actions routed through the same approval workflows, role-based permissions and audit logs as human changes. A rebuilt AI Visual Editor (Chrome extension, Pro/Enterprise) turns plain-language prompts into fully configured A/B tests and can generate and test images without a designer. Inside the app, AI generates experiment result summaries, SQL for the Explorer, metric descriptions and hypothesis feedback, and detects similar past experiments using vector embeddings; self-hosted deployments can enable these with their own OpenAI key. The self-hosted MCP server (@growthbook/mcp, API key plus email) exposes 16 tools across flags, experiments, metrics, environments, projects, SDK connections and docs search. Earlier AI work — the WebLens hypothesis generator and multi-armed bandits — remains part of the platform.

vendors.name: Kameleoon
vendors.h1: Build experiments in minutes by chatting with AI
vendors.h2: Kameleoon's AI platform allows you to build, test, and roll out impactful experiments in one place. From the first test to final release, you're in control.
vendors.summary: Kameleoon's AI stack centres on Prompt-Based Experimentation (PBX), which generates production-grade UI variations on the live site from natural language, with Master Prompts, Figma import and a browser extension; PBX Ideate (invite-only) analyses a site and returns prioritised, evidence-based hypotheses converted into PBX prompts. KAI, the in-app AI assistant, answers questions from documentation and experiment data and takes direct action on the account — creating experiments and feature flags — through Kameleoon's own MCP server, with no installation required. That MCP server (https://mcp.kameleoon.com/mcp, OAuth) also exposes seven tools to external IDE agents for listing and creating flags, listing experiments, pulling results and extracting raw variation code, and is available to non-developers as a Claude custom connector. AI Predictive Targeting scores each visitor's conversion probability for real-time activation, and AI-generated Takeaways consolidate insights across stopped experiments.

vendors.name: Statsig
vendors.h1: Measure what ships. Ship what matters.
vendors.h2: Test how each release - from features to AI-powered experiences - lands with customers, so you can protect trust and optimize at the speed of AI
compliance: EU-U.S. / UK / Swiss Data Privacy Framework
vendors.summary: Statsig's optimization core remains Autotune, a Bayesian multi-armed bandit that shifts traffic toward the best-performing variant, extended by contextual bandits that rank variants per user from attributes. Since December 2025 Statsig has layered AI across the experiment workflow: AI-powered experiment summaries that make an explicit ship recommendation, a hypothesis advisor that critiques hypotheses during setup, contextual AI descriptions, AI knowledge-bank search and AI stale-gate cleanup. Agent surfaces have expanded fastest: an OAuth-authenticated MCP server usable from Codex, Cursor and Claude Code, a Statsig ChatGPT app, and an agent-skills repository. MCP coverage now spans metrics tools, segments and layers, parameter store, autotune creation, version history and read-only access modes. Statsig also ships an AI Evals product for offline and online LLM evaluation alongside the experimentation platform.

vendors.name: Webflow Optimize
vendors.h1: Learn what performs. Deliver it at scale.
vendors.h2: Run experiments, personalize for every visitor, and let AI deliver the winning experience — whether your site is built on Webflow or not.
vendors.summary: Webflow Optimize is Webflow's native A/B testing and personalization add-on, combining three approaches in one platform: traditional A/B testing, rules-based personalization, and AI-powered optimization that learns what content works best for each visitor down to a 1:1 level. Critically, works on sites NOT built on Webflow — not just Webflow-hosted sites. Webflow AI Assistant proposes variant suggestions, generates copy for headlines/CTAs/body, and provides predictive audience insights. AI Optimize is a real-time decision engine that selects the best variant per visitor using machine learning. Webflow operates an open-source MCP server (github.com/webflow/mcp-server) that translates natural-language prompts from LLM agents (Cursor, Claude) into Webflow Data API calls — self-hosted or Webflow-hosted with OAuth authentication. Operations include list collections, create items, update styles, publish site. SDKs: JavaScript/TypeScript (js-webflow-api), Python (webflow-python), with OAuth or site-specific tokens. Browser API auto-injected on Optimize-enabled sites (wf.onVariationRecorded, wf.setAttributes). Pricing: $299/mo add-on for up to 500K page-views with 5 concurrent optimizations; Enterprise custom-quoted for higher volume. Native warehouse exports: BigQuery (real-time streaming via webhooks) and Redshift (direct destination connector). Integrations: GA4, HubSpot, Klaviyo. Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, SAML SSO. HIPAA not confirmed. Customers include Ideo, Monday.com, BBDO, The New York Times, TED.

vendors.name: Compose
vendors.h1: The only pay as you go A/B testing platform on the market
vendors.h2: Unleash the power of next-gen experimentation while only paying for what you need with our unique pay-as-you-go pricing.
vendors.summary: Compose is a no-code, Shopify-native A/B testing app positioned as an affordable alternative to Convert, AB Tasty, VWO, and Optimizely. Only pay-as-you-go pricing on the market: free to install plus $0.0012 per tested user (unique visitor in an active experiment). Supports theme/template testing, product page tests, collection tests, JavaScript variants in a code editor for advanced custom logic. Visual editor integrates directly with Shopify storefront. Native checkout integration. No AI/agentic features documented in marketing materials. No MCP server documented. No compliance certifications publicly listed. Targets small-to-medium Shopify merchants seeking flexibility and low-cost experimentation.

vendors.name: Amplitude
vendors.h1: AI Analytics Platform for Modern Digital Analytics
vendors.h2: Build better products by turning your user data into meaningful insights, using Amplitude's digital analytics platform and experimentation tools.
compliance: EU-U.S. / UK / Swiss Data Privacy Framework
vendors.summary: Amplitude's AI layer now centers on agentic surfaces: Custom Agents and Agent Connectors shipped in June 2026, Session Replay Agent v2 reached GA, and AI Feedback Auto Analysis landed at the end of June. The Amplitude MCP server is the primary machine interface - a vendor-hosted, OAuth-authenticated endpoint at https://mcp.amplitude.com/mcp (EU: https://mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp) that lets AI clients search and read charts, dashboards, notebooks, experiments and cohorts, run segmentation, funnel and retention queries, analyze experiment results, manage tracking-plan taxonomy, and create or edit charts, dashboards, experiments, cohorts, feature flags and metrics. MCP access respects existing Amplitude permissions and gained role-based access controls and a Slackbot surface in June 2026. A progressive tool-discovery mode reduces token cost by exposing discovery tools first and loading categories on demand. A separate read-only Docs MCP server serves Amplitude's public documentation without authentication.

vendors.name: Dynamic Yield
vendors.h1: Personalization & Experimentation Pioneers
vendors.h2: Dynamic Yield's Experience OS delivers digital experiences that are personalized, optimized, and synchronized.
vendors.summary: AdaptML is the core AI engine providing real-time affinity profiles, next-best-item predictions, and multi-purchase cadence modeling. Recommendations engine uses deep learning, visual similarity, and reinforcement learning for product catalogs with millions of SKUs. Predictive Targeting scores audiences for uplift potential. Copywriter + Stability.ai integration enables automated copy and visual generation. NextML NLP models predict next-best-item. Shopping Muse is a generative AI commerce advisor (users describe needs, e.g., 'outfit for a beach wedding in Bali'). Acquired by Mastercard in 2022, the platform now incorporates Mastercard Element spend signals. Snowflake connector via Improvado for warehouse export; raw event data via Daily Activity Stream. No Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for external AI assistants documented.
